adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`... : null,`), and then team calendars are added via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. If organizer has no destination calendar, the optional-chained `push` is a no-op, so collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are silently dropped and won’t be used downstream (e.g., `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` only iterates when `destinationCalendar.length > 0`). Additionally, when persisting the booking, only `evt.destinationCalendar[0].id` is connected (`connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`), so even if multiple destination calendars exist on the event, only the first is stored on the booking record.
